analogy.rationale: ATP-sensitive potassium (KATP) channels are hetero-octamers of Kir6.x (KCNJ8/KCNJ11/KCNJ10/KCNJ1) and sulfonylurea receptors (ABCC8); drugs blocking these channels share the potassium-channel-blocking mechanism, and sulfonylureas/insulin secretagogues act on the same ABCC8-KCNJ11 complex. However, these channels are largely absent or silent in the tested cell lines, so transcriptional responses should be weak.
